note: Hand-written stand-in for a model response so the demo runs without an API key. Re-record with --llm record.

output.explanation: amount.value was String(total) on a floating-point sum, so a cart of three $0.10 stickers was sent as "0.30000000000000004" and PayPal rejected the order with DECIMAL_PRECISION. A small helper now rounds in minor units and formats with the currency's decimal places (two for USD, zero for JPY, HUF and TWD) before the value goes to PayPal.
